GesolvFi: Capital in Orbit

GesolvFi is a working DeFi application for Robinhood Chain (chain id 4663) built around one settlement asset, USDG, and one vault. Five stations run from one connected terminal: Orbit Vault, an ERC-4626 vault that backs every index position; Global Index Perpetuals, synthetic exposure to 34 equity benchmarks executed at the first oracle level after the request; Sealed Order Crossing, WETH/USDG batches settled at the Chainlink level, Adaptive Liquidity Ladders, owner-owned rungs with oracle-checked fills; and a Launchpad with on-chain fee routes, where buyback & burn is live. Every enabled button sends a genuine transaction and every unavailable action says why. The contracts are unaudited.

He used to watch the market.
Now he owns a piece of it.
$SHCAT is where stock culture meets meme culture — built around a simple idea: even a cat can become a shareholder onchain.
One cat. One ticker. One seat at the table.🐱📈
The cat didn’t change. Its portfolio did.

$THRONE connects Ashen Throne gameplay with alliance competition on Robinhood Chain.

Stake for ASH: when staking opens, eligible players can link a verified wallet and stake THRONE for a share of daily spend-only ASH for eligible purchases in the web game. ASH allowance cannot be transferred or cashed out and expires after seven days. Unstaking takes seven days. Staking opens separately after launch.

Fund the Cup: 50% of qualifying THRONE creator fees contribute to the Alliance Cup prize reserve, supporting weekly alliance competition. Prizes are earned through eligible gameplay, not token ownership. Buying or staking THRONE is not required to compete. Payouts follow review and treasury approval.

Build your Crawler. Rally your alliance. Fight for the Citadel.
